changelog:
Initial release of European patent claim review workflow.

- Enables structured review of European patent application claims and supporting materials for EPO/EPC compliance and examination readiness.
- Guides users through mapping claim sets, assessing clarity and support (Articles 84, 83, 123(2), 82, 54, 56 EPC), and analyzing unity, novelty, and inventive step.
- Provides claim interpretation and amendment guidance under current EPO practice, including G 1/24 and 2026 Guidelines.
- Supports document handling, input assumptions, claim-category classification, and amendment-basis mapping.
- Distinguishes between document-only review and searches, clearly labeling provisional assessments when required materials are missing.
- Delivers a comprehensive stepwise workflow and mandatory issue checklist for European patent practitioners.
summary: Review European patent application claims under EPC and EPO practice
